gloss: a frog in a well; someone with a narrow worldview

definitions.explanation: A proverb describing someone with a narrow worldview who is unaware of the larger world outside their limited experience. Often used critically or as self-deprecation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{井|い}の{中|なか}の{蛙|かわず}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{気|き}づいた→気づく：01933_kizuku⟧。
examples.english: After going abroad, I realized I had been a frog in a well.

examples.japanese: {井|い}の{中|なか}の{蛙|かわず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ように→よう：01114_you⟧、⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{視野|しや}→視野：08659_shiya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}とう→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: Let's keep a broad perspective so we don't become frogs in a well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{井|い}の{中|なか}の{蛙|かわず}⟦で→だ：09496_da⟧、⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: He's a frog in a well who knows nothing about the world.

notes:
PROVERB MEANING:
A frog living at the bottom of a well can only see a small circle of sky above and thinks that is the entire world. The proverb criticizes people with limited experience who don't realize how much they don't know.

FULL VERSION:
The complete proverb is {井|い}の{中|なか}の{蛙|かわず}⟦{大海|たいかい}→大海：29270_taikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らず→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (a frog in a well doesn't know the ocean).

EXTENDED VERSION:
A positive continuation sometimes added: {井|い}の{中|なか}の{蛙|かわず}⟦{大海|たいかい}→大海：29270_taikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らず→知る：00458_shiru⟧、⟦されど→されど：noentry⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{深|ふか}さ→深さ：05328_fukasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (but it knows the depth of the sky) - meaning even limited perspectives can offer unique insights.

ENGLISH EQUIVALENTS:
- A big fish in a small pond
- Living in a bubble
- Seeing only a small part of the picture
